items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled theorem at source lines 359-361 (book Theorem 4.2.13): for every map f the type of half adjoint equivalence structures on f is a mere proposition. The statement is a propositionality claim about a nested structure, and the proof (source lines 362-367) has to choose the right reduction: it first turns propositionality into contractibility under an assumed inhabitant, then rewrites the structure by associativity of the Sigma type so that the coherence datum is taken at the right inverse rather than at the inverse map, and only then can it invoke the two contractibility results and the closure of contractibility under Sigma types. Which component the structure should be flattened at, and why that is the right choice, is exactly what the statement does not show.
